surface: Complete against overlayscrollbars-react 0.5.6: OverlayScrollbarsComponent and useOverlayScrollbars over the overlayscrollbars ^2 peer. Body-host document takeover tests are an explicit gap.
divergences: Octane has no forwardRef; OverlayScrollbarsComponent takes ref as a prop and exposes { osInstance, getElement } through useImperativeHandle.
The root element prop is a string host tag rendered with createElement, not a generic React ElementType.
Public children types use OctaneNode and do not import React.
ssr: useOverlayScrollbars defers initialization with no-op idle/rAF helpers when window is undefined. OverlayScrollbarsComponent still renders the host tag and contents wrapper; the overlayscrollbars instance is created in an effect on the client.
